en.summary: Fixes cache-bank replay data selection so a replayed write uses replay data rather than the low word of a simultaneous memory fill response.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says this is an MSHR replay bug fix.
The patch changes the cache-bank data-source mux in hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bank.sv.
The new logic gives replay data priority over mem_rsp_data for the writable word when WRITE_ENABLE is active.
evidence: Before the fix, the low writable word preferred mem_rsp_data whenever mem_rsp_valid was true, even if replay_valid was also true.
After the fix, the WRITE_ENABLE case explicitly selects replay_data before mem_rsp_data.
The upper words of the line still come from mem_rsp_data, matching the intended merge of replay-word data with fill-line data.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A replayed store or partial-line update must use the data saved with that replay entry, even if a fill response arrives in the same cycle. The old logic still took the writable low word from the fill response whenever mem_rsp_valid was asserted, which overwrote the replayed store payload with stale fill data.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A replayed write reaches the cache bank in the same cycle as a memory fill response.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Prefer fill-response data over replay data for the writable word of the replayed operation.
portability_notes: Apply this in caches that merge replay, core-request, and fill data before writing a line.
The bug usually affects only the word or byte lanes that the replayed store intends to update.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the data mux that selects between replay data, core request data, and fill data before the cache-array write.
On the write-enabled path, reorder the mux so fill data wins over replay data when both are valid in the same cycle.
Leave the rest of the fill-line merge logic unchanged.
Do not alter replay arbitration or MSHR bookkeeping.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: data_sel low-word mux in VX_cache_bank replay and fill arbitration
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix makes replay_valid override mem_rsp_valid for the writable word when WRITE_ENABLE is enabled.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the old low-word priority so mem_rsp_data overrides replay_data whenever mem_rsp_valid is asserted.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A replayed store writes stale or incorrect data into the cache line, which later appears as wrong load results or corrupted cache state.
evidence_for_injection: The changed logic is the low-word data mux that feeds the cache-bank pipeline.
Replay already has highest arbitration priority, so the old mem_rsp-first data choice was inconsistent with the selected request source.
Only the cache-bank RTL file is touched.
notes: This bug needs a concurrency trigger: replay_valid and mem_rsp_valid must overlap.
If the target cache updates bytes rather than words, inject the same wrong priority at byte granularity.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 cache bank 的 replay 数据选择逻辑，使 replay 写入使用 replay 保存的数据，而不是同时到达的内存 fill 响应低字。
why_it_counts: 提交说明明确指出这是一个 MSHR replay bug fix。
补丁修改的是 hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bank.sv 中的 cache-bank 数据源 mux。
修复后的逻辑在 WRITE_ENABLE 打开时，让 replay_data 在可写字上优先于 mem_rsp_data。
evidence: 修复前，只要 mem_rsp_valid 为真，低位可写字就优先选择 mem_rsp_data，即使 replay_valid 同时为真。
修复后，在 WRITE_ENABLE 场景下，代码显式让 replay_data 先于 mem_rsp_data。
cache line 其余高位字仍然来自 mem_rsp_data，说明预期是“低字来自 replay，其余字来自 fill”。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: replay 的 store 或部分行更新必须使用 replay 项中保存的数据，即使同周期有 fill 响应到达。旧逻辑在 mem_rsp_valid 为真时仍然从 fill 响应中取低位可写字，从而用陈旧 fill 数据覆盖了 replay 的 store 负载。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: MSHR replay 写数据源优先级
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一次 replay 写入与一次内存 fill 响应在同一个周期到达 cache bank。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在 replay 操作的可写字上，让 fill-response 数据优先于 replay 数据。
portability_notes: 适用于在写入 cache line 前需要在 replay、core 请求和 fill 数据之间做合并选择的缓存。
该 bug 通常只影响 replay store 真正要覆盖的字或字节 lane。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 cache-array 写入前，在 replay、core 和 fill 三类数据之间做选择的数据 mux。
在写路径上调整优先级，使 replay 和 fill 同时有效时由 fill 获胜。
保持其余 fill-line 合并逻辑不变。
不要改动 replay 仲裁或 MSHR 记账逻辑。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_cache_bank 中 replay 与 fill 仲裁阶段的 data_sel 低字 mux
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复后，在 WRITE_ENABLE 打开时，低位可写字由 replay_valid 优先覆盖 mem_rsp_valid。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复旧的低字优先级，让 mem_rsp_data 只要有效就覆盖 replay_data。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 一次 replay 的 store 会把陈旧或错误的数据写入 cache line，后续表现为 load 返回错误值或 cache 状态损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁修改的位置正是送入 cache-bank 流水线的低字数据 mux。
replay 已经具有更高仲裁优先级，因此旧的 mem_rsp-first 数据选择明显不一致。
只修改了 cache-bank RTL 文件。
notes: 该 bug 需要 replay_valid 与 mem_rsp_valid 重叠。
如果目标缓存按字节更新，就在字节粒度上注入相同的错误优先级。
